WITH per_order_item AS (
  SELECT
    order_item_id,
    AVG(derived_product_cost / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS invoice_line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY order_item_id
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg_per_item_ratio,
  AVG(invoice_line_item_count) AS avg_invoice_line_items_per_order_item
FROM per_order_item;

assumptions.assumption: Each row in Invoice_Line_Items is counted as one invoice line item; missing ratios are NULL when either cost is NULL or the total cost is zero, and are ignored by AVG.
